articles.title: Suhana Khan's FIRST LOOK in 'King' revealed? Fans spot mystery girl in Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone's 'Tu Mil Jaaye' music video – WATCH
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone's latest song, 'Tu Mil Jaaye', from their upcoming film 'King' has fans dissecting every frame for clues about the
articles.body: Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone's latest song, 'Tu Mil Jaaye', from their upcoming film 'King' has fans dissecting every frame for clues about the film's possible plot and storyline. While the romantic track primarily features the two stars in a series of glossy, colourful and aesthetically shot sequences, eagle-eyed fans believe they have spotted Suhana Khan in a blink-and-you-miss-it moment.Towards the two-minute mark, a brief shot, appearing to be part of an action-packed montage, has fans guessing that they may have finally found a first official look of Suhana. Although the girl's face is not visible, the clip shows a figure standing and looking towards a house engulfed in flames. Fans have taken to social media to speculate whether the girl could be Suhana, who is expected to share screen space for the first time with her father, Shah Rukh.Fans spot Suhana Khan in music videoThe brief glimpse has already sparked several fan theories about the characters and the possible plot of 'King'. Reacting to the shot, one fan commented, "Suhana Khan?" Another wrote, "I guess this is suhana khan from the new song of King." A third viewer wondered, "Is Suhana Khan Holding Head of Something...!!???"Suhana Khan's appearance spark fan theoriesOne elaborate fan theory suggested, "Suhana is holding Deepika's head ..Deepika is playing mother of Suhana. I think Deepika will be killed by the the enemy gang of King and they will chase Suhana also to kill her. Now King has to save Suhana and take his revenge."Another fan speculated about a possible family tragedy in the film, writing, "Yeah Suhana’s whole family will be kiIIed including her mom Rani by the same mafia which killed Deepika. SRK-Suhana uniting to take down the common enemy"Others wondered whether Suhana's character would survive the events depicted in the song, "Does Suhana khan's character die here, or she meet Rani's character and eventually become the main lead? Whatever the situation, one thing is certain: the father-daughter emotions in King are going to be absolute MAYHEM."Another fan pointed out that the mystery surrounding the film was only adding to the excitement, "The best part is that nobody even knows the film's plot yet! It's shaping up to be a proper Christmas bonanza for family audience. We've already had glimpses of emotions, romance & action. Suhana Khan here guarantees a storm is about to Hit!!"'King' cast and release date'King' brings Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone together again on screen, while Suhana's reported involvement has fuelled speculation about an emotional father-daughter storyline. Directed by Siddharth Anand the film features an ensemble cast including, Abhishek Bachchan, Jaideep Ahlawat, Abhay Verma, and Arshad Warsi in key roles.'King' is slated for a Christmas 2026 release.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection Day 18: Rajinikanth and Nelson's film ends third weekend with Rs 11.20 crore haul; film surpasses Rs 807 crore worldwide
articles.summary: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' has managed to maintain a tight grip on the global box office as it makes its way towards the Rs 810 crore mark at the worldwide
articles.body: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' has managed to maintain a tight grip on the global box office as it makes its way towards the Rs 810 crore mark at the worldwide box office.'Jailer 2,' directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, has held up well even in its third week of release. The film's performance across Tamil, Telugu, Hindi and Kannada versions has helped it maintain steady momentum. Its overseas business has also played a major role in pushing the overall collection beyond Rs 800 crore.'Jailer 2' Day 18 box office collection crosses Rs 11 croreOn Day 18, Sunday, November 1, 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 11.20 crore net in India from 8,906 shows, according to Sacnilk. The Tamil version remained the biggest contributor, earning Rs 8 crore through 4,287 shows. The Hindi version added Rs 1.75 crore from 3,592 shows, while the Telugu version collected Rs 1 crore across 777 shows. The Kannada version contributed another Rs 45 lakh from 250 shows.With these earnings, the film's total India net collection has reached an estimated Rs 456.30 crore, while its domestic gross stands at Rs 533.75 crore. The film recorded an average collection of Rs 12,576 per show on its 18th day.Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' overseas collection pushes worldwide totalThe performance of the film globally has further improved its box office collection figures. 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 3 crore from international markets on Day 18, taking the overseas total gross collection to Rs 273.50 crore. Combined with domestic collection figures, the film's worldwide gross collection has reached the Rs 807.25 crore mark.Will 'Jailer 2' be able to collect Rs 1,000 crore worldwide?Since 'Jailer 2' box office collection has crossed the mark of over Rs 807 crore worldwide, everyone's attention is now focused on whether it can come a step closer to the prestigious Rs 1,000 crore club. There is still a long way to go. How close it gets to hitting the mark depends on its collections. Right now, 'Jailer 2' has achieved yet another feat for Rajinikanth in terms of box office performance.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalised. articles.title: 'Queen beauty and Killer abs.': Karan Johar is impressed by 'King' song 'Tu Mil Jaaye'; praises Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone
articles.summary: Karan Johar has shared a positive reaction to 'Tu Mil Jaaye', the first song from Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film 'King'.
articles.body: Karan Johar has shared a positive reaction to 'Tu Mil Jaaye', the first song from Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film 'King'. The filmmaker praised the track's music, visuals and the leading actors after watching the romantic number. His comments have added to the attention surrounding the song, which features Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone.The track was unveiled as a birthday surprise for Shah Rukh Khan, who turned 61. Its release gave fans their first musical glimpse of the film, which is scheduled to arrive in theatres on December 24, 2026. The song has also generated discussion on social media, particularly over the pairing of Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone.Karan Johar reacts to 'King' song 'Tu Mil Jaaye'Karan Johar shared his response through Instagram Stories after reposting the song. His note highlighted the audio and visuals, while also complimenting Deepika Padukone's appearance and Shah Rukh Khan's physique. He tagged both actors, along with director Siddharth Anand, in the post.Karan Johar wrote, "King audio! King visuals, Queen beauty and Killer abs. Blockbuster music charts are all ready for this one,"Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone feature in romantic track'Tu Mil Jaaye' brings Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone together in a romantic dance sequence. The visuals showcase their on-screen chemistry, with the song combining a lively musical arrangement and elaborate choreography. Their pairing has become one of the talking points following the release.The track also features a dialogue delivered by Shah Rukh Khan: 'Main qaatil nahi, aashiq hoon, aur nishana meri mashooka, aur woh aashiq hi kya jo dil cheer na de'. The line adds a dramatic touch to the romantic presentation and offers a glimpse of the character's attitude.Arijit Singh, Ed Sheeran and Madhubanti Bagchi lend their voicesThe song brings together Arijit Singh, Ed Sheeran and Madhubanti Bagchi as singers. Sachin-Jigar have composed the music, while Kumaar has penned the lyrics. Choreography has been handled by Piyush-Shazia.Ed Sheeran has also contributed the English rap featured in the track. His involvement adds an international collaboration to the film's soundtrack. The combination of Indian singers, an international artiste and Sachin-Jigar's composition has made the song one of the key musical highlights of the film's promotional campaign.Shah Rukh Khan's dialogues add dramatic momentsAlongside its romantic portions, 'Tu Mil Jaaye' includes another dialogue from Shah Rukh Khan. The line, 'Iss baar dil mein aag lagi hai, ab duniya jalaye bina manega nahi', introduces a more intense tone. It also hints at the action-driven world of 'King'. Song has all the elements of SRK style romance mixed with action.'King' is an upcoming Hindi-language action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand. The film features Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone, alongside Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan. The project is scheduled for a theatrical release on December 24, 2026.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan pays emotional tribute to Sanjay Gupta: ‘Companions from the world of art are being snatched away’
articles.summary: Sanjay Gupta, the filmmaker who gave audiences 'Kaante', 'Kaabil' and 'Shootout at Wadala', passed away on October 30 at the age of 59, reportedly after a
articles.body: Sanjay Gupta, the filmmaker who gave audiences 'Kaante', 'Kaabil' and 'Shootout at Wadala', passed away on October 30 at the age of 59, reportedly after a fall in the bathroom of his Mumbai home. His passing has sent shockwaves through the industry, with tributes flowing in from colleagues, friends and fans. Among them is Amitabh Bachchan, who turned to his blog to share his grief and remember a man whose stylish, high-octane films left a lasting mark on Hindi cinema.Amitabh Bachchan’s blog post on Sanjay Gupta’s demiseReacting to the filmmaker’s death, Amitabh shared a heartfelt post on his blog on Sunday. Writing in Hindi, the veteran actor said, “A friend, a fellow artiste and a true devotee of art has left us at such a young age! I am unable to understand how all of this is happening. Our dear companions from the world of art are being snatched away from us. What wrong have they done to deserve such a fate? People say that all the powerful planets in the solar system have turned unfavourable at the same time.”He added, “Please have mercy on us! Those who are raining their wrath upon us – is this really fair? May all the planets in the solar system retreat to their respective homes and stay apart from one another. Perhaps then they will stop troubling all of us!".Sanjay Gupta’s ‘Kaante’ connection with BachchanBachchan collaborated with Sanjay on 'Kaante', a film that also starred Sanjay Dutt, Suniel Shetty, Lucky Ali, Mahesh Manjrekar and Kumar Gaurav in key roles. Dutt and Shetty have also shared emotional posts on social media remembering the filmmaker, and fans have responded with an outpouring of love and support.Sanjay Gupta’s journey from post-production to directorIn recent years, Sanjay directed 'The Miranda Brothers' (2024), starring Meezaan Jafri and Harshvardhan Rane, and 'Visfot' (2024), with Riteish Deshmukh and Fardeen Khan in the lead roles. His journey in cinema began behind the scenes: he worked in post-production and sound design, and assisted filmmaker Pankaj Parashar on projects such as the TV series 'Karamchand' and the film 'Jalwa'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
